interface.title: iTrace - eye-movement session dashboard (Streamlit page written by the run over iTrace library calls)
interface.field: Eye tracking / oculomotor research and pupillometry
interface.stage_of_work: Analysing a recorded or simulated session, and checking event detectors against ground truth before trusting their output
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a gaze CSV (and optionally a pupil CSV), or simulate a session with known ground truth, then detect fixations, saccades and microsaccades with adjustable settings and review the main sequence, pupil statistics, recording quality and detector recovery across synthetic stress domains.
interface.note: This Streamlit page (seed/dashboard_app.py) was written by the run as a front end over iTrace library calls, because the repo's own dashboard is a stub. The repo's real interactive UI is live-html, which needs a camera and was not explored. Workflows here describe the library's analysis functions as exposed by this page, not a UI the repo ships.

data.note: I uploaded demo_gaze.csv (151 samples at 50 Hz over 3 s) and demo_pupil.csv. I also used the built-in synthetic generator: 6 saccades, seed 0, noise 0.02, then 10 saccades, seed 1, noise 0.06, dropout 0.00. The demo saccades were found as described: 12 deg at 0 deg direction (onset 0.76 s) and 9 deg at -45 deg (onset 2.38 s). The demo dropout appeared as dropout_fraction 0.013, and the pupil blink was counted (n_blinks 1). The replay used a different synthetic session (8 saccades, seed 7, noise 0.03, dropout 0.01).

features.name: Threshold slider that re-runs event detection
features.general: Move a detection-threshold slider and see event counts, event table, distributions and fitted law update right away; read back the threshold actually used
features.specific: Drag the I-VT velocity threshold (deg/s) slider; the Fixations/Saccades tiles, Saccades table, amplitude fit, scanpath and main-sequence fit recompute, and Recording-quality diagnostics reports detection_threshold_deg_s. Bug: the 2-D speed panel's dashed threshold line and legend stay at 'threshold (30 deg/s)' whatever the slider value, so read the threshold from diagnostics, not the plot
steps: load or generate a session
drag the I-VT threshold slider (10-100 deg/s)
read the Fixations/Saccades counts and the shaded speed trace
check detection_threshold_deg_s in diagnostics (the plotted line does not follow the slider)
compare against ground truth if synthetic

Fit and inspect a power-law relation between two event measures

features.name: Synthetic ground-truth generator with a truth table for comparison
features.general: Simulate a dataset with chosen event count, noise, missing-data rate and random seed, then compare detected events row by row with the known truth
features.specific: Sidebar section 2 (Number of saccades, Dropout fraction, Gaze noise, Seed) plus Generate synthetic session; 'Synthetic ground truth (for comparison)' appears below the detected Saccades table. Dropout 0.10 crashes with a ValueError (0.01 works)
steps: set number of events, noise and seed
optionally set a small dropout fraction
press Generate synthetic session
read the detected-events table against the ground-truth table below it
change the detector setting and compare again
serves_tasks: Simulate a dataset with known ground truth, varying its difficulty
Compare detected events with the known truth

features.name: Multi-panel session summary figure
features.general: One composite figure: signal speed over time with threshold and event shading, a spatial path of dwell points, an event-size histogram with a fitted distribution, a log-log scaling-law fit, a polar direction histogram and a text summary; can be opened full screen
features.specific: iTrace session dashboard (session_dashboard): 2-D speed, Scanpath, Amplitude distribution (gamma AIC/KS), Saccadic main sequence (power b, R^2), Saccade directions, Session summary with scanpath string. Static matplotlib image. The speed panel's threshold line and legend are fixed at 30 deg/s and do not follow the slider
steps: load or generate a session
read the speed trace and scanpath
read the amplitude and direction distributions
read the main-sequence fit
press Fullscreen to enlarge
serves_tasks: Inspect the speed trace and spatial path with detected events marked
Look at the distributions of event size and direction
Fit and inspect a power-law relation between two event measures

features.name: Multi-condition validation suite with per-condition drill-down
features.general: Run a detector over several simulated stress conditions with repeated seeds, get a cross-condition summary naming the worst condition, then expand each condition for metrics with mean, std and confidence interval
features.specific: Repetitions per domain slider, Run synthetic validation suite, Cross-domain summary (macro/min/max saccade F1, stability_gap_f1, worst_domain), and expanders for clean_desktop, webcam_jitter, head_drift and low_light_dropout. Uses its own detector settings and ignores the sidebar I-VT threshold
steps: set repetitions per domain (1-5)
press Run synthetic validation suite and wait for the spinner
read the cross-domain summary and worst_domain
expand a domain to read F1/precision/recall/MAE with confidence intervals
rerun with more repetitions to tighten estimates
serves_tasks: Benchmark detector recovery over several simulated conditions with repeated seeds
Drill into one condition's recovery metrics with confidence intervals

features.name: Pupil summary statistics
features.general: Summarise a physiological size trace as level, spread, blink count and fraction, baseline, response peak, latency to peak, response area and phase fractions
features.specific: Pupillometry block (st.json): mean/std/min/max size, n_blinks, blink_fraction, baseline_size, response_peak_size, latency_to_peak_s, dilation_auc, phase_fraction_*; reads 'No pupil data loaded.' without a pupil CSV. A copy icon copies a single hovered value; copying the whole dict was not confirmed
steps: load a gaze CSV together with a pupil CSV
scroll to Pupillometry
read blink count/fraction and the response measures
collapse the block or copy a value
serves_tasks: Read summary statistics of a physiological trace

features.name: Recording-quality report
features.general: Check a recording's fitness before trusting results: valid-sample fraction, sampling rate, missing-data fraction, timing jitter, longest gap, count of large gaps, out-of-order timestamps, and the detection threshold actually applied
features.specific: Recording-quality diagnostics block: finite_sample_fraction, sampling_rate_hz, dropout_fraction, sampling_jitter_s, longest_gap_s, large_gap_count, nonmonotonic_timestamp_count, detection_threshold_deg_s
steps: load or generate a session
scroll to Recording-quality diagnostics
check dropout, gaps, jitter and timestamp order
confirm detection_threshold_deg_s matches the intended setting
serves_tasks: Check data-quality diagnostics before trusting results

A per-microsaccade table: only the count, rate and scanpath code appear

The repo's own live-html interface, which needs a camera

I could not confirm the CSV export: pressing Download as CSV on the Saccades table produced no captured download (screens/022.webp), and the replay saw the same
I could not confirm copying the whole Pupillometry dict: the replay found the copy icon copies only the single hovered value
I could not see blink interpolation itself: only n_blinks and blink_fraction are reported, with no before/after trace

I did not see any microsaccades on the uploaded demo (count 0), so I only judged microsaccade detection by the synthetic count (21) and the toggle to 0; the replay's session showed 0 microsaccades both on and off, and the toggle does not change the scanpath string

The speed-trace legend always reads 'threshold (30 deg/s)' and its dashed line stays at 30, even at slider values of 60, 70 or 100. Diagnostics confirm the slider value is the one used for detection, so the plotted threshold is misleading

The validation suite ignores the sidebar I-VT threshold: at the same repetitions it gave identical results at 100 and at 70 deg/s, so the current detector setting cannot be validated from this interface
I did not choose a different detection method (only I-VT plus optional Engbert & Kliegl is exposed), and there is no per-domain selection in the validation suite
